name: Kanzaki Keiko
source:
[i]Mother of Asuka who serves as the parent-teacher association president.[/i]

[url=/c37530]Kanzaki Asuka's[/url] mother. She serves as the President of the Tatsuryou Accademy Parent-Teacher Association.

She is a friendly woman, but like Asuka, she has a strong sense of justice and responsibility.

She is proud of his daughter and alongside her is trying to lead the school in the right direction.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/medorei/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
